The '''Royal Academy''', also known as '''Theed Academy''', was the school in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] where the young nobles of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] trained to become governmental leaders.

[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] studied at the Royal Academy.

[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Mi Fon Lu]] was an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] at the Theed Academy.<ref name="SWG:AAP">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|An Archeologist's Problem|Mustafar}}</ref>
